sql: select x.strategy, count(*) as open_now from (select distinct lo.market_ticker, lo.strategy from live_orders lo where lo.action='buy' and lo.status in ('pending','unknown','submitted','resting','partial','filled')) x left join lateral (select coalesce(p.quantity_fp, p.quantity) as qty from positions p where p.market_ticker = x.market_ticker order by p.captured_at desc limit 1) pos on true where pos.qty is null or abs(pos.qty) > 0.01 group by x.strategy order by x.strategy
